# Decision: <decision-id> — <title>

Copy this master to `.codex/decisions/<decision-id>.md` and update `decisions/index.json`.

- Status: `proposed | accepted | superseded | rejected`
- Date: `<date>`
- Owners: `<responsible people or roles>`
- Supersedes/superseded by: `<references>`

## Context

Describe the concrete forces, constraints, evidence, and uncertainty that require a decision.

## Options

Compare viable options using the same criteria. Include operational and migration cost; do not invent provider or platform capabilities.

## Decision and consequences

State the selected option, why it fits, benefits, costs, risks, reversibility, and required follow-up. Link affected specifications and plans.
